prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with concussion after a rear-end collision. The patient had 7 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1175; do not mention it.)
text:
Treatment Summary

The patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with complaints of headache, dizziness, light sensitivity, difficulty concentrating, and neck stiffness. Initial evaluation was consistent with concussion, and a neurological examination was performed with no focal deficits identified. Cervical range of motion was reduced, and mild tenderness was noted over the paraspinal muscles.

Over the course of seven office visits, the patient was managed with graduated rest, activity modification, and a stepwise return-to-activity plan. Symptom tracking was used at each visit, with a gradual reduction in headache frequency and improvement in concentration and tolerance to screen use reported over time. Cervical physical therapy was added to address neck stiffness and range of motion deficits, with steady progress noted.

At the most recent visit, the patient reported that most symptoms had largely resolved, with residual intermittent neck discomfort. Cognitive symptoms were improved, and the patient was cleared for gradual return to work and school with ongoing restrictions on contact activities. Follow-up will continue as needed, with instructions to return sooner should any warning symptoms develop.
